candidates.description: This vector activates for common subwords and morphemes in Hindi and related Devanagari script languages.
This vector activates for common substrings and characters found in Hindi text.
This vector represents Hindi character sequences and digits associated with subword tokenization noise.
These tokens represent fragments, characters, and subwords associated with the Devanagari script and the consonant "भ" (bha).
These tokens represent conjunct consonants and common consonant clusters in the Devanagari script.
This feature vector activates on Devanagari vowel sign and anusvara characters attached to commas or trailing punctuation marks.
These tokens represent conjunct consonants and character ligatures in the Devanagari script.
This feature vector is related to subword tokens and characters from Indic scripts like Hindi.
This vector activates for the Devanagari retroflex sibilant letter "ष" and its various vowel and consonant conjunct combinations, alongside occasional transliterations.
This feature vector activates on subwords, suffixes, and character fragments commonly found in Hindi script and Devanagari transliteration.
